title: Example
lead: Two walkthroughs of how you and an agent ship a tabletop project. Stories and diagrams only. This page does not run the Skill or any sim.

shared.title: Pick a lifecycle
shared.body: First-time makers and working designers iterate differently. Pick the track that matches how you work. You can switch later; beginner chapters link out when a topic goes deeper.

objects.name: State
objects.body: design-state.md: durable project memory across chats.

objects.name: Claim
objects.body: A falsifiable hypothesis with a confidence level.

objects.name: Experiment
objects.body: One variable, a baseline, and a success metric.

objects.name: Prototype
objects.body: Lowest fidelity that can answer the question.

objects.name: Artifact
objects.body: Files in the repo, not advice that dies in chat.

invariants: System metrics do not prove fun.
shared.diagramTitle: Two shapes of the same Skill

beginner.name: Beginner
beginner.summary: Short loop: idea, plain structure, home PnP, play, plain diagnose, one change, then keep / rethink / pause. Case: Cat Cafe.

designer.name: Designer
designer.summary: Milestones 0-5 with one restructure: modes, sims, balance, lint, and a publish boundary. Case: Night Market.

ui.demoNote: Copy prompts into your agent after install. Diagrams show the collaboration. Nothing on this page executes the Skill.
